summary: The solar-powered repair kiosk operates as an autonomous, eco-friendly transit hub amenity. Solar photovoltaic panels capture and store renewable energy in an onboard lithium battery bank to run diagnostic scanners, automated dispensing compartments, and repair equipment. Commuters drop off small electronics, wearables, or micro-mobility components (e.g., e-bikes, tires), initiating automated diagnosis, payment, and fast on-site repair or component swapping, finalized with SMS/app pickup confirmation.
steps: Step 1: Energy Harvesting & Management - Rooftop solar canopy harvests solar energy, mediated by an MPPT charge controller and stored in high-capacity onboard battery banks to power kiosk systems 24/7.

Step 2: User Check-in & Intake - Commuter approaches kiosk at transit terminal and selects service category (mobile tech, quick solder, tire inflation/patch, micro-mobility tune-up) via interactive touch terminal.
Step 3: Rapid Diagnostics - Device or item is placed in a multi-sensor diagnostic bay, which scans for battery health, continuity, hardware faults, or tire pressure.
Step 4: Automated Quote & Approval - Kiosk generates instantaneous price/repair-time estimate; commuter authorizes transaction via contactless mobile payment (Apple Pay, RFID transit card).

Step 5: Robotic/Assisted Repair Execution - Internal automated robotic arm or assisted workbench tooling executes targeted repair (battery swap, screen patch, inflation, plug repair) within a secure chamber.
Step 6: Quality Verification & Pickup - Optical and electrical verification runs; commuter receives an authentication PIN or QR code to retrieve the repaired item from the retrieval locker.

flowchart TD
    subgraph PowerSystem["Power Subsystem"]
        SP[Rooftop Solar PV Array] --> CC[MPPT Charge Controller]
        CC --> BATT[Battery Storage Bank]
        BATT --> PMU[Power Management Unit]
    end

    subgraph UserInteraction["Commuter Intake"]
        U([Commuter]) --> UI[Touchscreen UI / Mobile App]
        UI --> INT[Secure Intake Chamber]
    end

    subgraph DiagnosticAndRepair["Automated Core Engine"]
        PMU -.-> DIAG[Sensor Array & Diagnostics]
        PMU -.-> TOOL[Robotic & Tooling Module]
        INT --> DIAG
        DIAG --> QUOTE[Dynamic Quote & Auth]
        QUOTE -->|Payment Confirmed| TOOL
        TOOL --> QC[Automated QC & Testing]
    end

    subgraph Fulfillment["Dispatch & Retrieval"]
        QC --> LOCK[Secure Pickup Locker]
        LOCK --> NOTIF[SMS / Push Notification]
        NOTIF --> RETRIEVE[Commuter QR Pickup]
        RETRIEVE --> U
    end
